## Covenant Extraction: Draft Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (D2, draft of Sept 22, 2026)

This is a re-extraction of the table provided earlier in this chat. On re-reading D2 §1.1, two reasons in the earlier table were wrong: "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" and "Lien" are defined in the excerpt [D2, §1.1]. The confidence flags and reasons below are corrected accordingly, and the leverage covenant is re-flagged Medium for consistency with the DSCR covenant, since both depend on "Equipment Notes," which is not defined in the excerpt.

| # | Covenant | Type | Requirement as written | Test frequency | Source | Confidence | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Maximum Total Leverage Ratio | Financial | "The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.25 to 1.00; provided that for each fiscal quarter ending on or after December 31, 2027, the maximum shall be 3.00 to 1.00." | Quarterly, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter; EBITDA measured over the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended | [D2, §7.1]; definitions [D2, §1.1] | Medium | Levels and step-down date are explicit, and Total Leverage Ratio, Total Funded Debt and EBITDA are defined; but Total Funded Debt includes "the Equipment Notes," a capitalized term not defined in the excerpt. |
| 2 | Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio | Financial | "The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.00 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter." | Quarterly, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, on a trailing four-quarter basis | [D2, §7.2]; definitions [D2, §1.1] | Medium | Level is explicit, and Debt Service Coverage Ratio, EBITDA and Unfinanced Capital Expenditures are defined; but the denominator references Total Funded Debt, which includes "the Equipment Notes," not defined in the excerpt. |
| 3 | Capital Expenditures limit | Financial | "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures shall not exceed $2,500,000 in any fiscal year; provided that capital expenditures for the Expansion Project, not exceeding $6,000,000 in the aggregate, shall be excluded." | Per fiscal year | [D2, §7.3]; definitions [D2, §1.1] | Medium | Dollar limits are explicit and Unfinanced Capital Expenditures is defined; but "Expansion Project" is defined by Schedule 1.1, which is not included in the excerpt. |
| 4 | Annual audited financial statements | Reporting | "within 120 days after the end of each fiscal year, annual consolidated financial statements audited by an independent accounting firm acceptable to the Lender" | Annually, within 120 days of fiscal year end | [D2, §7.4(a)] | High | Deadline and deliverable stated explicitly. |
| 5 | Quarterly financial statements | Reporting | "within 45 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, internally prepared quarterly consolidated financial statements" | Quarterly, within 45 days of quarter end | [D2, §7.4(b)] | High | Deadline and deliverable stated explicitly. |
| 6 | Compliance Certificate | Reporting | "together with each delivery under clause (b), a Compliance Certificate signed by a financial officer of the Borrower, showing the calculations of the Total Leverage Ratio under §7.1 and the Debt Service Coverage Ratio under §7.2 for the period then ended." | Quarterly, with each delivery under §7.4(b) | [D2, §7.4(c)] | High | Timing, signatory and required calculations stated explicitly; "Compliance Certificate" is capitalized but its content is specified in the clause itself. |
| 7 | Negative Pledge | Negative | "(a) The Borrower shall not create, incur or permit to exist any Lien on any of its assets, except Permitted Liens." Permitted Liens: "(i) Liens in favor of the Lender; (ii) Liens securing the Equipment Notes, limited to the equipment financed by those notes; (iii) purchase-money Liens securing indebtedness in an aggregate amount not exceeding $1,000,000 at any time outstanding; and (iv) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable." | Not stated; wording is "create, incur or permit to exist" | [D2, §7.5(a), §7.5(b)]; "Lien" defined [D2, §1.1] | Medium | "Lien" is defined and the $1,000,000 purchase-money basket is explicit; but clause (ii) depends on "Equipment Notes," not defined in the excerpt. |
| 8 | Use of proceeds restriction | Negative | "The Borrower shall use the proceeds of the Term Loan and the revolving loans only to refinance the existing term loan owed to the Lender, to fund the Expansion Project, and to pay fees and expenses in connection with this Agreement." | Not stated | [D2, §2.1(c)] | Medium | Permitted uses are listed, but "Expansion Project" is defined by Schedule 1.1, which is not included in the excerpt. |
| 9 | Change of Control | Default trigger | "It shall be an Event of Default if the Founders cease to own, directly or indirectly, a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests of the Borrower, or cease to be actively involved in the management of the Borrower." | Not stated | [D2, §7.6]; "Founders" defined [D2, §1.1] | Low | "Meaningful portion" and "actively involved" are not defined or quantified in the excerpt; reasonable readers could disagree on when the trigger occurs. |

**Items for legal and underwriter review**

1. Capitalized terms used but not defined in the excerpt: "Equipment Notes," "Closing Date," "Permitted Liens" (listed in §7.5(b) but not in §1.1), "Compliance Certificate." The excerpt states such terms "have the meanings given in the full draft agreement," which is not provided [D2, header]. Legal to confirm from the full draft.
2. Schedule 1.1 (definition of "Expansion Project") is not included in the excerpt [D2, §1.1]. It governs the use-of-proceeds restriction [D2, §2.1(c)] and the capex carve-out [D2, §7.3].
3. §7.6 Change of Control: "meaningful portion" and "actively involved" are ambiguous and are flagged, not interpreted. Referred to the underwriter and legal. Related cited facts, without interpretation: ownership is Erik Halvorsen 55%, Maria Halvorsen 25%, Anders Halvorsen (COO) 20% [D5, ¶1]; Erik Halvorsen (64) plans to hand the CEO role to Anders within three years, and the family has discussed "informally" selling a minority stake to a private equity firm, with no timeline and no LOI [D5, ¶5]; "Founders" means Erik Halvorsen and Maria Halvorsen [D2, §1.1].
4. Interaction between §1.1 and §7.3: the definition of Unfinanced Capital Expenditures already excludes capex "financed ... with the proceeds of the Term Loan" [D2, §1.1], and §7.3 separately excludes Expansion Project capex up to $6,000,000 [D2, §7.3]. Whether these two exclusions overlap, and how Expansion Project spending funded from sources other than the Term Loan is treated, is referred to legal and the underwriter; not interpreted here.
5. The Compliance Certificate under §7.4(c) covers calculations for §7.1 and §7.2 only; the excerpt does not provide for certification of the §7.3 capex limit [D2, §7.4(c)]. Underwriter to decide whether this is intended.
6. Terminology: D1 spreads use "Unfunded capex" [D1, Table 1: Unfunded capex] while D2 uses "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" [D2, §1.1; §7.3]. Underwriter to confirm whether the spread definition matches the agreement definition.
7. Covenant levels differ from the existing 2023 agreement: existing maximum total leverage 3.50x and minimum DSCR 1.20x [D3, Part B §4; D1, §7]; draft maximum 3.25 to 1.00 stepping to 3.00 to 1.00 for quarters ending on or after December 31, 2027 [D2, §7.1] and minimum DSCR 1.25 to 1.00 [D2, §7.2]. Not a conflict; different agreements. Noted for the underwriter.
8. Pro forma figures for the underwriter's headroom review, stated as written: pro forma total leverage 2.52x and pro forma DSCR 1.38x on an FY2025 basis [D1, Table 3: Total leverage; DSCR]. No headroom calculation is performed here.
9. The first test date for §7.1 and §7.2 after the Closing Date is not stated in the excerpt [D2, §7.1; §7.2].
10. Prior reporting covenant history: the Q4 2024 compliance certificate arrived 18 days late and Credit Administration waived the reporting covenant (waiver W-25-0117); all later certificates arrived on time [D5, ¶3].
11. The excerpt reproduces selected sections only [D2, header]. Other covenants, events of default, cure periods and remedies that may exist in the full draft agreement are not in the provided documents.
